essence: The prescribed hand posture is either the swan-wing gesture or the downward-facing banner gesture.
The distance from the hand's tip to the navel-thread end measures fifteen aṅgulas.
The distance from the forearm root to the heart's middle should be five aṅgulas.
The wrist-band should measure nineteen units from the side.
The deity should be endowed with an equal bend and a standing posture.
